status: Source-prefix model-family development only; no future metric may be opened by this protocol.
claim_boundary: Passing this source gate can freeze an exploratory model for an already examined cohort. It cannot establish a SOTA claim without a fresh independent evaluation.
source_panel_selection: One canonical single_lift interaction per released MatPhys material label, chosen from names and metadata before source-validation metrics were computed.

method.training_scope: one shared checkpoint across the five source cases
method.video_frame_contract: uniform numeric filename IDs before the fit boundary

family_gate.reference: paired exact teacher rerun generated in the same export
family_gate.interval: remaining 25 percent of the released observation prefix
family_gate.score: equal mean of candidate/teacher CD and track-error ratios

source_acceptance.aggregate_metrics: learned-or-teacher selected stack must improve both validation CD and validation track error over the all-teacher stack
source_acceptance.specialization_diagnostic: report per-part spring-ratio means and their range; no minimum range is target-tuned
source_acceptance.identity_requirement: paired scale-zero teacher trajectories must preserve the released PhysTwin state contract

forbidden: future metric inspection during source-family selection
retuning part count, residual bound, or source cases after gate results
calling the released 22-case cohort independent or confirmatory
calling graph Voronoi parts a reproduction of unpublished MatPhys preprocessing
